name: linter-driven-development
description: Rules-as-data linter-driven development workflow for any language: the same 12 rules, thin directional skills (design, TDD implementation, refactoring, testing, review, documentation) and hunter/skeptic/critic review as the Go plugin, with the language detected from the repository at run time and its own linter run instead of a bundled one; plus an OKF-conformant repo brain with a shippable CI conformance gate
